name: Game developer
summary: Writes game code for small studios in Unity: movement, menus, saves and game rules, with tests. Fixes physics and timing bugs.

changelog.note: First release: 30 sources (Unity 6.6 manual, Unity 6.3 LTS and pricing; Godot 4.7 and Unreal 5.8 docs; Steamworks fee, review, Coming Soon, Content Survey, uploads and Cloud; IARC, Play content ratings, PEGI June 2026 rules, ESRB; Apple and Play loot box odds; UK, EU and FTC action). Four skills, five prompts, two workflows, training files.
